subject: Post-call recap and request: influence map + procurement path for Acme Health
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap and next steps — influence map + procurement path

Hi Evan / Priya — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our 11/30 discovery and three asks to keep momentum: 

Key notes from the call:
- Goal: pilot Redwood Inference for near-real-time clinical summarization in two pilot hospitals (PHX + SFO).
- Primary success criteria: 95% uptime during business hours, 250ms median token latency for 512-token responses, and cost-per-100k tokens under our committed threshold.
- Data flow/hosting preference: must run in their VPC, encryption-at-rest and audit logs required.

Three asks to help us qualify + assemble the right internal team:
1) Influence map/org chart: can you share a simple org chart or list of decision makers (economic buyer, procurement lead, security owner, legal reviewer)? If possible highlight who signs off on vendor contracts.
2) Procurement/security path: attach (below) is our lightweight procurement questionnaire — please share with your procurement or sourcing lead and let us know expected review SLAs and any mandatory legal language.
3) Preferred timeline & procurement kickoff: what’s the target go/no-go date and the earliest procurement review meeting we can expect?

Attachments (stubs):
- procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB) — quick tick-boxes + 6 security questions
- NDA_DRAFT.pdf (pdf, 98KB) — standard mutual NDA; we can accept redlines

If you prefer, a short 20–30 min procurement sync with procurement + security + legal next week will help us map dependencies. I can prepare a one-page rollout options doc and a pricing sketch for the pilot.

Thanks — I’ve cc’d Laura for SLO/liveness expectations and to capture any technical constraints.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

- Economic buyer: Mohan Patel (CFO) — he’ll need a short exec summary and expected TCO for the pilot.
- Procurement lead: Priya Shah (cc’d) will own the procurement timeline and vendor onboarding checklist.
- Security owner: that’s myself initially; I’ll pull in our InfoSec engineer if they need deeper docs.

Karthik: can you draft two pricing options (pilot: hosted + private VPC) with a short note on tradeoffs (throughput, latency, unit cost) and one high-level TCO for a 3-month pilot? Put numbers in a simple table and include assumptions.

Laura: can you prepare a one-page SLO/latency expectations doc and a short note on what we’d need to enable VPC deployment (network egress, KMS integration, audit logs)?

Aditya: please prepare a 30–45 sec elevator blurb on the customer success/playbook for hospital pilots — I’ll include it in the exec summary for Mohan.

I’m going to ask Priya for procurement timeline and flag that legal may redline the NDA. If legal asks for SOC 2 evidence, we have the SOC 2 summary deck in the drive link below.

Attachments (internal stub): pricing_sketch_v1.pdf (pdf, 24KB)

Thanks — let’s aim to have the drafts ready by 11:30 PT so I can consolidate and send to Acme.

Best,
Mina
